ORDINANCE #1349 EXTENDING THE TEMPORARY ZONING CODE MORATORIUM
ENACTED THROUGH ORDINANCE#1339 FOR AN ADDITIONAL ONE-HUNDRED

EIGHTY DAYS THIRD READING

Councilman Waits moved to accept Ordinance #1349 extending the temporary
zoning code moratorium enacted through Ordinance #1339. Councilwoman Howell
seconded the motion.

Aroll call vote was administered by Mayor Ogden. Howell Yea, Carnahan Yea, Lang
Yea, Vineyard Yea, Waits Yea. Motion carried.

The ordinance number and exact adoption date of the August measure were not located. Meanwhile the Planning Commission held a 2026-09-16 public hearing on a draft 'High Tech Overlay' that would regulate (not ban) data centers on the DB STU LLC mega-site; no council vote yet.

7-D Resolution No.: 26-R-28 Sponsor: Mayor Rector

A RESOLUTION DECLARING A 6-MONTH STAY ON THE FILING,

CONSIDERATION, REVIEW, AND/OR APPROVAL OF ALL NEW
APPLICATIONS FOR DATA CENTERS AND RELATED ACTIVITIES IN THE
CITY OF NEW FRANKLIN; AND DECLARING THAT THIS RESOLUTION
SHALL BE EFFECTIVE IMMEDIATELY UPON PASSAGE

It was moved by Mr. Klusty and seconded by Mr. Powell to waive the three-reading rule.

ROLL CALL: YES: Cotts, Shaffer, Jones, Powell, Klusty, Wolff, Allman

It was moved by Mr. Klusty and seconded by Mr. Powell to adopt Resolution 26-R-28.

ROLL CALL: YES: Shaffer, Jones, Powell, Klusty, Wolff, Allman
NO:  Cotts
